title: Beautiful and practical
text: Beautiful and practical. Even though it is a little larger than I expected, it is beautiful, and much more convenient than the upright napkin holders.  It is almost impossible to remove just 1 napkin from an upright holder.  With this new 1, they lay flat, and have metal bar weighing them down.  There is also a notch along the front to make it possible to remove 1 at a time.

product_metadata.title: Acanthus Leaf Brown Cast Metal Napkin Holder
features: Never have a napkin fly away again, this exceptionaly stylish cast metal napkin holder's enclosure bar secures your napkins in place until you need them
Use classic white or pretty printed 7-inch by 7-inch napkins to complete your table setting or buffet table
Charming "Old World" styling is seen in the vintage scrolling of cast metal Acanthus Leaf motif
Hand wash the intricate cast metal of this napkin holder with mild soap and dry with a soft cloth
Use this small item, so detailed, beautifully made to make an entire table setting look more formal and expensive
description: The traditional scrollwork of this napkin holder is inspired by the casual elegance of Old-World serving piece designs. Use classic white or pretty printed 7-inch by 7-inch napkins to complete your table setting or buffet.The cast metal braided bar sits atop so that your napkins will stay secure until you need them. Crafted from durable intricate cast aluminum in an antique brown finish, this traditionally styled napkin holder is a luxurious complement to formal and holiday dinner table arrangements.
